name: Mailchimp Sync for WooCommerce Memberships
author: Misha Rudrastyh

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to sync your site users with Mailchimp audiences depending on the WooCommerce Membership plan they have.

You may specify a Mailchimp audience for any status of any WooCommerce Memberships plan.

If you already have members on your site, you can use the resync feature to add them to the appropriate Mailchimp audiences.

That’s it! Mailchimp Sync for WooCommerce Memberships seamlessly updates data of your site members in their subscriber profiles, ensuring Mailchimp data is always up-to-date with your latest membership list and statuses.
sections.installation:
Automatic Install

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for “Mailchimp Sync…”
  3. Click “Install Now” under the Mailchimp Sync for WooCommerce Memberships plugin
  4. Click “Activate Now”

Manual Install

  1. Download the plugin from the download button on this page
  2. Unzip the file, and upload the resulting mailchimp-sync-woocommerce-memberships folder to your /wp-content/plugins directory
  3. Log into your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins
  4. Click “Activate” under the Mailchimp Sync for WooCommerce Memberships plugin
